task.summary:
Fix: Restore UI stability and Camera functionality after rollback
- CameraBehaviour: Resolved syntax error in HandleZoom caused by merge conflict. - CameraBehaviour: Updated IsMouseOverUI to correctly block clicks when interacting with topStatsHUD and taskPanel. - CharacterStats: Refactored UpdateHealth to use the Health property, ensuring stat changes correctly trigger UI update events. - UIManager: Restored critical null safety checks in UpdateCharacterStatsDisplay and UpdateTimeDisplay to prevent UI logic crashes from unassigned fields. - InventoryItemUI: Added null checks to Setup method for safer prefab instantiation.
Add inventory management features and UI enhancements
Add task management system with task population and integration
Add layout management and item type definitions for inventory system. task addition and completion fully integrated with interaction manager
Add CharacterCarousel class and integrate with UIManager for character selection
Add CharacterCarousel class and integrate with UIManager for character selection
Add ObjectPlacementActivator class for dynamic object activation based on inventory items
